note: The bounded evaluation-policy vocabulary (Technical Schema v1.1 §9). Ships with the engine, not with a bundle. An EvaluationSemantics record stores only the dimensions it explicitly sets; the evaluator resolves each dimension as (stored value ?? behaviourPreservingDefault). A dimension introduced later must declare a default that reproduces the world before it existed.
